paite: Huai lai in Jeroboam tapa Abijah achina hi.
heading: Jeroboam Tapa Sihna
english: At that time Abijah the son of Jeroboam became sick.

paite: Jeroboam in azi kiang ah, "Thou inla, Jeroboam zi na hi chih ahon theihtheihlouhna ding un kihihlamdang inla, Shiloh ah va hoh dih; ngai in, huai ah zawlnei Ahijah, hiai mite tung a kumpipa dia ka hong om ding ka tungtang thu genpa a-om hi.
english: Jeroboam said to his wife, “Please get up and disguise yourself, so that you won’t be recognized as Jeroboam’s wife. Go to Shiloh. Behold, Ahijah the prophet is there, who said that I would be king over this people.

paite: Tanghou beu sawm leh tanghou pei lian lou leh khuaizu thawl khat tawi inla, akiang ah va hoh dih. Naupang omdan ding hon na hilh ding," achi hi.
english: Take with you ten loaves of bread, some cakes, and a jar of honey, and go to him. He will tell you what will become of the child.”

paite: Jeroboam zi in huchibang in ahih a, athou a, Shiloh ah ahoh a, Ahijah inn ah ava hohta hi. Ahijah in khua amu thei nawn kei a; a-upat ziak in amit amialta hi.
english: Jeroboam’s wife did so, and arose and went to Shiloh, and came to Ahijah’s house. Now Ahijah could not see, for his eyes were set by reason of his age.

paite: TOUPA'N Ahijah kiang ah, "Ngai in, Jeroboam zi atapa tungtang a thu dong ding in ahong, achi ana a, chi in hichibang in na hilh ding ahi. Huan hichi ahi ding a, ahong lut chiang in numei dang hileh kilawmtak in ahong kibawl ding,” achi hi.
english: Yahweh said to Ahijah, “Behold, Jeroboam’s wife is coming to inquire of you concerning her son, for he is sick. Tell her such and such; for it will be, when she comes in, that she will pretend to be another woman.”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Ahijah in ahong lut lai a akhesik ging ana zaktak in, "Nang Jeroboam zi hong lut dih ve. Bang achia ahia midang dan a na kibawl? Tanchin hoih loutak nang hon hilh dia sawl ka hi.
english: So when Ahijah heard the sound of her feet as she came in at the door, he said, “Come in, Jeroboam’s wife! Why do you pretend to be another? For I am sent to you with heavy news.

paite: Pai nawn inla, Jeroboam kiang ah, TOUPA'N, Israelte' Pathian in hichi in achi: Mipite lak a pan ka hon tawisang a, ka mi Israelte tung ah heutu in ka hon bawl hi.
english: Go, tell Jeroboam, ‘Yahweh, the God of Israel, says: “Because I exalted you from among the people, and made you prince over my people Israel,

paite: David inkuante gam ka sut a, huai nang ka hon pia hi. Himahleh nang ka sikha David bang in na om kei. Ama'n zaw ka thupiakte azui a, ka mitmuh a thil hoih kia hih tum in alungtang tengteng in ahon zui hi.
english: and tore the kingdom away from David’s house, and gave it to you; and yet you have not been as my servant David, who kept my commandments, and who followed me with all his heart, to do that only which was right in my eyes,

paite: Himahleh nang bel na ma a mite tengteng sang in thil na hihkhial mahmah se a, na hon hehsakna ding in pathian dangte leh milim sunte na bawl a, na hon nungngatsanta hi.
english: but have done evil above all who were before you, and have gone and made for yourself other gods, molten images, to provoke me to anger, and have cast me behind your back,

paite: Huaiziak in ngai in, Jeroboam inkuan tung ah thil hoih lou ka tungsak dia, Jeroboam a pan ta pasal taphot Israel gam a mi nehden leh den louh leng ka hihmang dia, mi'n ek aphiatsiang sipsip bang in Jeroboam inkuan agam vek masiah ka phiatmang ding hi.
english: therefore, behold, I will bring evil on the house of Jeroboam, and will cut off from Jeroboam everyone who urinates on a wall, he who is shut up and he who is left at large in Israel, and will utterly sweep away the house of Jeroboam, as a man sweeps away dung until it is all gone.

paite: Jeroboam inko lak a mi, khopi a si peuhmahte ui in ane dia; gam a si peuhmahte tung a leng vasate'n ane ding uh. Hiai TOUPA'N agen khinta hi.
english: The dogs will eat whoever belongs to Jeroboam who dies in the city; and the birds of the sky will eat whoever dies in the field, for Yahweh has spoken it.”’

paite: "Huchi in thou inla na inn ah pai nawn mai in, khopi sung na sik chiang in huai naupang asi ding hi.
english: Arise therefore, and go to your house. When your feet enter into the city, the child will die.

paite: Huchi in Israel tengteng in asuun ding ua, avui ding uh. Jeroboam inkote lak ah amah kia han akoih ahi ding hi. Jeroboam inko lak ah amah kia a TOUPA Israelte' Pathian lam a thil hoih omsun ahi.
english: All Israel will mourn for him and bury him; for he only of Jeroboam will come to the grave, because in him there is found some good thing toward Yahweh, the God of Israel, in the house of Jeroboam.

paite: TOUPA'N amah a dia Israelte tung a kumpipa hi ding; Jeroboam inkuan hihmang ding mi khat atungkhe ding hi. Himahleh bang eita? Huai ni ding, tu mah ahi.
english: Moreover Yahweh will raise up a king for himself over Israel who will cut off the house of Jeroboam. This is the day! What? Even now.

paite: TOUPA'N lah tui a phaiphek lingling bang mai in Israelte ahon sat ling dia; huchi in TOUPA hehsak a Asherte uh abawl ziak un apute uh ana piaksa, hiai gam hoihtak a pan Israelte abotkhe siang vek dia, lui khen lam ah ahon hihzak vek ding hi.
english: For Yahweh will strike Israel, as a reed is shaken in the water; and he will root up Israel out of this good land which he gave to their fathers, and will scatter them beyond the River, because they have made their Asherah poles, provoking Yahweh to anger.

paite: Israelte thil hihkhialsak a, ahih Jeroboam khelhnate ziak in Israelte alehngatsan ding,” achi hi.
english: He will give Israel up because of the sins of Jeroboam, which he has sinned, and with which he has made Israel to sin.”

paite: Jeroboam zi athou a, apawtkhia a, Tirzah khua ava tung a; inn kongpi bul atuntak in huai naupang asita hi.
english: Jeroboam’s wife arose and departed, and came to Tirzah. As she came to the threshold of the house, the child died.

paite: TOUPA'N asikha zawlnei Ahijah zang a thu agen bang ngei in Israel tengteng in avui ua, asuunta uhi.
english: All Israel buried him and mourned for him, according to Yahweh’s word, which he spoke by his servant Ahijah the prophet.

paite: Jeroboam tanchin dang, agaldou thute leh avaihawm thute, ngai in, Israel kumpipate khangthubute ah gelh in a-om hi.
heading: Jeroboam Sihna
english: The rest of the acts of Jeroboam, how he fought and how he reigned, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.

paite: Huchi in Jeroboam vaihawm sung kum sawmnih-le-nih ahi a, apute kiang ah a-ihmuta a, amah sik in atapa Nadab ahong lalta hi.
english: The days which Jeroboam reigned were twenty two years; then he slept with his fathers, and Nadab his son reigned in his place.

paite: Solomon tapa Rehoboam Judah gam ah alal hi. Alal tung lai in Rehoboam kum sawmli-le-khat a upa ahi. TOUPA'N amin omsakna dia Israel nam tengtengte lak a atel khopi Jerusalem ah kum sawm-le-sagih alal hi. Anu min Naamah ahi a, amah Ammon mi ahi.
heading: Judah Kumpipa Rehoboam / (2 Kro 11.5-12.15)
english: Rehoboam the son of Solomon reigned in Judah. Rehoboam was forty-one years old when he began to reign, and he reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem, the city which Yahweh had chosen out of all the tribes of Israel, to put his name there. His mother’s name was Naamah the Ammonitess.

paite: Judahte'n TOUPA mitmuh in thil gilou ahih ua; apute uh thilhih tengteng khup in akhelhnate un ahazatna atokthou uhi.
english: Judah did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, and they provoked him to jealousy with their sins which they committed, above all that their fathers had done.

paite: Mual sang teng ah leh sing hing teng nuai ah suangphuhte phut in mun sangte leh Asherte nangawn abawl ngal ua.
english: For they also built for themselves high places, sacred pillars, and Asherah poles on every high hill and under every green tree.

paite: Huai gam ah pasal kizuakte leng a-om ua; Israel suante ma a TOUPA'N adelhkhiak namte thilhih kihhuai chiteng ahih uhi.
english: There were also sodomites in the land. They did according to all the abominations of the nations which Yahweh drove out before the children of Israel.

paite: Kumpipa Rehoboam lal akum nga kum in hichi ahong hi a, Aigupta kumpipa Shishak in Jerusalem asual hi.
english: In the fifth year of King Rehoboam, Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem;

paite: TOUPA' inn a goute leh kumpipa' inn a goute ala a, avek in ala khin hi. Solomon dangka-eng lum bawl tengteng leng ala tel vek hi.
english: and he took away the treasures of Yahweh’s house and the treasures of the king’s house. He even took away all of it, including all the gold shields which Solomon had made.

paite: Kumpipa Rehoboam in huaite tang in dal lumte abawl a, kumpipa' inn kongpi vengmi heutute akemsak hi.
english: King Rehoboam made shields of bronze in their place, and committed them to the hands of the captains of the guard, who guarded the door of the king’s house.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, TOUPA' inn a kumpipa alut peuhmah chiang in veng mite'n huaite atawi ua, dantan ah akoih nawn zel uhi.
english: It was so, that as often as the king went into Yahweh’s house, the guard bore them, and brought them back into the guard room.

paite: Rehoboam tanchin dangte leh athilhih tengteng Judah kumpipate khangthubute ah gelh ahi kei maw?
english: Now the rest of the acts of Rehoboam, and all that he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

paite: Rehoboam leh Jeroboam adamsung teng un akidou uhi.
english: There was war between Rehoboam and Jeroboam continually.

paite: Huchi in Rehoboam apute kiang ah a-ihmuta a, David khopi ah apute lak ah avui uh. Anu min Naamah ahi a, Ammon mi ahi. Asik in atapa Abijam ahong lalta hi.
english: Rehoboam slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in David’s city. His mother’s name was Naamah the Ammonitess. Abijam his son reigned in his place.
